facts.fact: Tanzania's mobile money has nearly 2 million agents, 75.8 million active accounts and 6.31 billion transactions in 2025, per the National Council for Financial Inclusion report.
The Tanzania Instant Payment System connects 47 financial service providers, and bank-to-wallet transfer charges have been reduced, per the report.
The Tanzania Instant Payment System, a national system, connects 47 financial service providers including for bank-to-wallet transfers, per the report.
